description: Export your unsubscribe list, oldest first, a page at a time: each entry's hash, reason, source and added_at, and the address only where you added it with keep_address. Start without after; while has_more is true, pass next_after as after. Use it for a backup (delete_utility_data asks for one first); before a send, use suppression_check. Works after the plan ended.

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if you have no app sign-in and cannot send a header.

name: suppression_export
title: Export my unsubscribe list
